findings.title: Browser tests can silently use the long-lived fallback database
findings.original_evidence: 2026-09-03 browser run: 4 accessibility errors and 11 adversarial failures; server warned TEST_DATABASE_URL was unset; procurement login failed.
findings.required_fix: Make release and smoke entry points fail closed unless an explicit disposable PostgreSQL database is supplied.
findings.verified_evidence: 2026-09-03: contract regression 3/3 passed; clean-database adversarial smoke cohort 11/11 passed; clean-database accessibility traversal passed.
closure_tests: A smoke invocation without TEST_DATABASE_URL must fail before browser launch
The same smoke test must pass against an explicitly named clean database

findings.title: Security matrix template used a raw safe bypass
findings.proposed_fix: Return Markup only from the autoescaping emitter and render without a template-level safe filter.

findings.title: Release test timeout was shorter than its one-hour contract
findings.proposed_fix: Use a 3600-second timeout per release suite.

findings.title: Release CI exercises Chromium only
findings.original_evidence: Smoke fixture launches p.chromium and no Firefox/WebKit release job is defined.
findings.required_fix: Define and execute the supported browser matrix; retain per-browser evidence. Safari support requires WebKit plus final real-device/service evidence where contractually required.

findings.title: Manual WCAG 2.2 AA and assistive-technology evidence is absent
findings.original_evidence: Repository contains axe and keyboard automation but no moderated NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver report.

findings.title: Collapsed platform-admin sidebar uses ambiguous duplicate icons
findings.original_evidence: Chromium smoke: test_the_collapsed_sidebar_stays_readable[platform_admin] found four icons each serving two destinations (layout-dashboard, gavel, shield-check, grid-3x3), baseline <= 1.

findings.title: Transformation objective page renders ambiguous duplicate revision controls
findings.original_evidence: Chromium smoke at 390px and 1024px: the test's page-wide input[name=expected_revision] locator resolved to two controls in separate, valid Programme context and Objective and scope forms.
findings.required_fix: Give the objective form a stable identity and scope the optimistic-lock probe to the revision control owned by that form; retain both valid form controls.
closure_tests: Transformation concurrency and form contract tests

findings.title: Six documented governance/AI-safety gates exist as scripts but are never registered in build_gates(), so they never run
findings.original_evidence: 3 Sep 2026, docs-audit worktree (branch docs/claude-md-drift-audit, base 2f7fdc5c): `grep -oE '^\s*Gate\("[a-z0-9-]+"' scripts/verify.py | sort -u | wc -l` -> 44, not the 67 docs/DELIVERY_CONTRACT.md claimed. `grep -rn "role-gate-coverage|ai-evidence-rules|ai-tool-guard|ai-untrusted-content|ai-approval-honoured|evidence-contract" scripts/verify.py` -> no matches. The six scripts (scripts/check_evidence_contract.py, scripts/check_role_gate_coverage.py, scripts/check_ai_evidence_rules.py, scripts/check_ai_tool_guard.py, scripts/check_ai_untrusted_content.py, scripts/check_ai_approval_honoured.py) exist on disk and are not wrapped in a Gate(...) entry in build_gates(), so none run as part of `python scripts/verify.py`, CI, or anywhere else found in the repository. Re-deriving DELIVERY_CONTRACT.md's role-to-gate table from the 44 gates that actually exist found 12 of 15 roles measure 0 real gates (including AI/ML architect, product architect, business architect, service designer, data/evidence analyst, integration architect), not the 1-8 the table claimed - because those roles' tags (ai, architecture, process, product, journey, business, handoff, evidence, integration, rendered, wayfinding, content) are not carried by any currently-registered gate. CLAUDE.md separately claimed 88/98 units of ratchet debt for design_tokens/raw_sql_tenancy that both currently measure 0, and documented 19 gates against the real 44 - both were also corrected in the same pass (see branch docs/claude-md-drift-audit for the full diff, not yet merged).
findings.required_fix: Register the six scripts as Gate(...) entries in scripts/verify.py's build_gates(), each with a Proven-against: line per DELIVERY_CONTRACT.md Rule 2 (reintroduce the defect, confirm red, restore, confirm green) before trusting them in the release gate - do not wire them in unproven, per this same document's own account of a gate it built and deliberately did not ship because it had false positives. Re-derive and correct docs/DELIVERY_CONTRACT.md's role-to-gate table once the real tag set is known.
closure_tests: grep -oE '^\s*Gate\("(evidence-contract|role-gate-coverage|ai-evidence-rules|ai-tool-guard|ai-untrusted-content|ai-approval-honoured)"' scripts/verify.py must match all six
Each of the six gates has a documented Proven-against case reproduced: reintroduce the named defect, gate goes red; restore, gate goes green
python scripts/verify.py includes all six in its run with zero unexpected new findings on the candidate SHA
docs/DELIVERY_CONTRACT.md's role-to-gate table matches a fresh run of scripts/check_role_gate_coverage.py --count against the corrected build_gates()

findings.title: Typed ARB browser qualification contains expected failures
findings.original_evidence: Main Chromium smoke run reported six xfailed typed-ARB cases. Isolated retest found one additional brittle tenant-leak assertion. On 3 Sep the assertion was corrected and passed; successful Architecture Model submission, browser Return for Evidence and cycle-2 resubmission, historical-unverified lock rendering, and corrupt-evidence failed rendering with HTTP 503 were converted to passing browser tests. Two expected failures remain: Solution response normalization and the real frozen Decision Brief fixture.
findings.required_fix: Replace every expected failure with deterministic passing end-to-end evidence or retain the associated behavior as an explicit release blocker; qualification cannot count xfail as green.
closure_tests: Typed ARB service and route suites

findings.title: Architecture Journey browser evidence skipped when seed had no journey
findings.original_evidence: Main Chromium run skipped the journey-home honesty check and two screenshot cases because the smoke tenant contained no ArchitectureJourney.
findings.required_fix: Seed one real business-architect-owned journey so home, honesty, and screenshot checks always execute.
closure_tests: Main Chromium qualification with zero missing-journey skips
